The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a2b847ce72f66109), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let G = (V, E) be a finite k-edge-connected multi- graph, and let Xv ∈ Q = [0, 1]h for v ∈ V . Suppose (ℱi) is a finite or countable λ-geometric se- quence of nonempty families of β-compact bags, of respective types (δi, Δi), where 0 < λ ≤ 1/12 and β ≥ 36. Thus all balls in ℱi are mutually disjoint ordinary balls BQ(Xv, δi), every bag D ∈ ℱi has at least two balls and center diameter at most Δi, and βΔi ≤ |D|δi, Δi+1 ≤ λδi. Then (B.31) k 4 ∑ i δi ∑ D∈ℱi |D| ≤ ∑ e∈E ‖Xe‖1, X{u,v} = Xu − Xv.
